summary: Child of ATTEMPT-ACT-PRIOR-FROM-INCORRUPTIBLE (#352): replace the root's use of act's simple priority for the first mover instead of sourcing it for dormant potency. Witnesses: Met. XII.7 newly pinned as ARIST-MET-XII-7 (Perseus Greek, same snapshot as IX.8) and read whole, with XII.6 (already pinned) for context; Aquinas, In Metaph. XII, lect. 7, newly pinned as AQUINAS-IN-METAPH-XII-L7 (Corpus Thomisticum Latin, web snapshot; the Wayback Machine was unreachable) and read whole; In Metaph. IX, lect. 8 n. 11 re-read. Findings. (1) Lambda.7, 1072b4-10 addresses exactly the countermodel of ACT-PRIOR-FROM-INCORRUPTIBLE-FACTS item 6: the first heaven, moved in locomotion, can be otherwise in place though not in substance, but the mover that moves while unmoved, being in act, can be otherwise in no way; lect. 7 n. 12-13 says the same (primum movens, quod est immobile et semper actu ens, nullo modo possit aliter et aliter se habere, quia non potest moveri). (2) Result ARIST-MET-XII-7-FIRST-MOVER-PURE-ACT (zero axioms, Comparator and NanoDa): the existential reading of 1072b7-8 (some mover moved in no respect and in act in being cannot be otherwise in any respect), at most one first unmoved mover, the unattributed bridge 'what can fail to be r can be otherwise in r', and every potency is of the contradictory give STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-IS-PURE-ACT, composing the pure-act corollary of ACT-PRIOR-FROM-INCORRUPTIBLE-FACTS. It does not use act's simple priority, non-simultaneity, or the first-being bridge. lambda7RouteFacts: each of the four premises is needed (omission models; the one without Lambda.7 is lect. 9 n. 6's case, a unique first mover with a dormant potency in place); all four hold with a first unmoved mover; and the universal sibling reading with moves-only-as-in-act and actuality-only-insofar-as-being gives the same without uniqueness. Readings recorded: -A (existential, Aristotle) and the Aquinas claim state STMT-SOME-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-OTHERWISE; -B (universal, sibling) states STMT-EVERY-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-OTHERWISE. Rejected or not used, with reasons: (a) reading ἀκίνητον modally ('cannot be moved') as the claim's hypothesis: 1072a25's participle (ὃ οὐ κινούμενον κινεῖ) supports 'not being moved', and the modal reading would not apply to the prima via's mover without a further premise; Aquinas' 'immobile' entails the weaker hypothesis that is formalized. (b) Sourcing the bridge from lect. 7 n. 13-15: n. 13 glosses the necessary as what cannot not be and applies it to the first motion, n. 14 lists 'what cannot be otherwise' as the third sense, and n. 15 denies that the first motion's necessity is of that kind, so the text distinguishes the two glosses rather than identifying them. (c) Identifying CanBeOtherwise with not-CanFailToBe by definition: under the bare-possibility sense of 'can fail to be r', an unchangeable being that is not r can fail to be r, so the identification is a substantive reading choice (DISAMB-CAN-FAIL-TO-BE-OR-BE-OTHERWISE). (d) Lect. 8 n. 11 (quousque veniatur ad primum movens, quod est in actu tantum) as a stating claim for STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-IS-PURE-ACT: still not formalized; it is said in passing, of the end of a series of generators in time, with no reason beyond the regress, and attributing it would make the pure-act statement a sourced leaf without an argument (skeleton cost 31 to 29 by the frontier rule); left as an owner question on #352. (e) Lambda.6, 1071b19-22 (a principle whose substance is actuality; without matter): read for context; its stated reason is about substance (what is potentially may not be), like Theta.8, so it was not used for act in every respect. (f) Lambda.7's ἀΐδιον (1072a25, b28-30) is not used, so no disambiguation of DEF-ETERNAL with DEF-INCORRUPTIBLE-SIMPLY is needed for this route. Recomposition: STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-IS-PURE-ACT now has two verified derivations. Frontier (--routes, --reaching-root): unchanged, 61 open (12 bare, 49 sourced), cheapest CATHOLICISM-SKELETON at 31; the per-statement minimum keeps the ST I q.3 a.1 derivation (3 leaves) over the Lambda.7 one (5 leaves with the uniqueness leaves, which the skeleton already pays). With the q.3 a.1 derivation removed, the skeleton stays at 31 (act's simple priority, non-simultaneity and the first-being bridge leave; the Lambda.7 reading, the potency of the contradictory and the bridge enter), and CATHOLICISM-FROM-PRIMA-VIA goes from 36 to 37. The stage-2 uses of act's priority (CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-GOD-IS-IMMUTABLE, -ETERNAL, the classical-attribute bundles and the composite routes that list it directly) were not rerouted: they apply it to the maximal being, and a reroute needs a premise that whatever is God (maximal in being) is a first mover moved by none, which no reading supplies; on the skeleton those statements are sourced leaves, so a reroute would not change its cost.
blocker: The Lambda.7 route is not cheaper under the frontier rule: it trades three open leaves (act's simple priority, non-simultaneity, the first-being bridge) for three (the Lambda.7 reading, the potency of the contradictory, the bare bridge STMT-WHAT-CAN-FAIL-TO-BE-CAN-BE-OTHERWISE). Next: source the bridge (candidate ARIST-MET-V-5-NECESSARY-CANNOT-BE-OTHERWISE) or defend it; then the route's only bare leaf is gone. The stage-2 uses of act's priority for the maximal being remain.
